title: Iterated conditioning on a subset
statement:
Let $\mu$ be a finite measure on a measurable space, and let $F \subseteq A$ be measurable sets. Then conditioning $\mu$ on $A$ and afterwards on $F$ gives the same measure as conditioning $\mu$ on $F$ directly:
\[
  (\mu[\,\cdot \mid A])[\,\cdot \mid F] \;=\; \mu[\,\cdot \mid F].
\]
hypotheses_covered: F is a subset of A
replaced:
For a finite measure $\mu$ and measurable sets $F \subseteq A$,
\[
  (\mu[\,|\,A])[\,|\,F] \;=\; \mu[\,|\,F].
\]
